articles.title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
articles.description:
Though there are no conclusive results yet, town officials suspect an algae bloom may be to blame for the water issues.

The post Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Residents are advised to keep pets away from Stoughton Pond following a dog's death.
Town officials suspect an algae bloom may be causing water quality issues.
Potential health risks for pets could affect local pet owners and their animals.

articles.title: How to spot the Perseid meteor shower, a summer light show that promises to dazzle
articles.description:
As many as 50 to 100 meteors per hour may be visible under ideal conditions, according to NASA.

The post How to spot the Perseid meteor shower, a summer light show that promises to dazzle appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: NASA predicts 50 to 100 meteors per hour during the Perseid meteor shower.
Ideal viewing conditions expected in Boston on August 12-13, 2026.
Residents encouraged to find dark areas for optimal meteor viewing experience.
